lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 김민수 님. 검사 결과 알려 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Mr. Kim Minsu. I'll tell you your test results.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo, gim minsu nim. geomsa gyeolgwa allyeo deurilgeyo.
lines.en: Yes, hello. How was my weight?

lines.beaver_en: Your weight went up a little. Do you exercise?
lines.en: I sometimes walk in the park in the evening.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Your breathing and temperature are normal.
lines.learner: 다행이에요. 그런데 계단을 오르면 숨이 차곤 해요.
lines.en: That's a relief. But I often get out of breath on stairs.
lines.roman: dahaengieyo. geureonde gyedaneul oreumyeon sumi chagon haeyo.

lines.beaver: 체중 때문일 수 있어요. 시력은 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: It may be because of your weight. How's your eyesight?
lines.beaver_roman: chejung ttaemunil su isseoyo. siryeogeun eottaeyo?
lines.learner: 시력이 나빠졌어요. 컴퓨터를 오래 보곤 해요.
lines.en: My eyesight got worse. I often look at a computer long.
lines.roman: siryeogi nappajyeosseoyo. keompyuteoreul orae bogon haeyo.

lines.beaver: 한 시간마다 눈을 쉬게 해 주세요. 다른 곳은요?
lines.beaver_en: Rest your eyes every hour. Anywhere else?
lines.beaver_roman: han siganmada nuneul swige hae juseyo. dareun goseunyo?
lines.en: My elbows and heels hurt sometimes.

lines.beaver_en: Do you often rest your elbows on the desk?
lines.learner: 네, 일할 때 팔꿈치를 대고 앉곤 해요.
lines.en: Yes, I often sit leaning on my elbows at work.
lines.roman: ne, ilhal ttae palkkumchireul daego angon haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 자세를 바꿔 보세요. 손톱 색도 괜찮네요.
lines.beaver_en: Then try changing your posture. Your nail color is fine.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom jasereul bakkwo boseyo. sontop saekdo gwaenchanneyo.
lines.en: I used to bite my nails, but I stopped.

lines.beaver_en: Well done. Do you go to the bathroom regularly?
lines.learner: 네, 매일 아침에 화장실에 가곤 해요.
lines.en: Yes, I usually go every morning.
lines.roman: ne, maeil achime hwajangsire gagon haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Do you get up easily in the morning?
lines.en: My body's fine, but my head feels a bit heavy.

lines.beaver: 운동하면 머리도 맑아져요. 다음에 또 봬요.
lines.beaver_en: Exercise clears your head too. See you next time.
lines.beaver_roman: undonghamyeon meorido malgajyeoyo. daeume tto bwaeyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll exercise to get healthier.
